paragraphs: QuickLaunch sells an identity and integration platform built only for higher education, covering students, faculty, staff, contractors and alumni. It gives institutions one place to secure those identities and to connect the systems a campus runs, from the SIS to the LMS to the cloud. Identity and access products include single sign-on, MFA options, passkey and facial-recognition passwordless access, first-time account claim and voice password reset.

A lifecycle product turns each enrollment change into an automatic provisioning, change or deprovisioning action, and adds access review campaigns, policy and role management, and analytics. An integration product connects campus systems, with an Agentic Design Studio that builds connectors from a description rather than from custom scripts. QuickLaunch is a Certified Ellucian Partner verified for SaaS integration on Banner and Colleague, and named clients include Pfeiffer University, Colorado Christian University, Alabama State University and CalArts.

quote.text: The identity and integration platform built only for higher education and the AI that runs and governs it.
